operation_details.item: The user completed the customer discovery interviews.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How is the customer discovery work progressing today?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good. With the guide ready, you can focus on listening for recurring needs rather than polishing a pitch. What is the current status of the interviews?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I completed the customer discovery interviews.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That gives you a useful evidence base before making scaling or investment decisions. Are you already turning the conversations into themes?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The synthesis of findings is in progress.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: A structured synthesis should help distinguish repeated signals from isolated requests. What remains on the discovery calendar?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Follow-up interviews are scheduled for next week.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That timing lets you test the emerging themes instead of rushing into a broad build. You could use the next few days to identify which assumptions need the clearest confirmation.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I want the synthesis to guide the next product decisions rather than simply support a polished pitch.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That is a strong operating principle. Keep the evidence connected to concrete decisions about the product, customer value, and how the company should scale.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I will use the follow-up conversations to challenge the strongest assumptions before committing resources.
